questions.text: How is the blood coming out?
Is the person awake and talking normally?

summary.LOW: Small bleeding. Not dangerous. Clean and cover it.
summary.MODERATE: Strong bleeding. Stop it now with firm pressure.
summary.CRITICAL: Life-threatening bleeding. Press hard now and alert the base.

LOW.text: Clean the wound with clean water.
Cover it with a clean dressing.

MODERATE.text: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.
Keep pressing. Add cloth on top if blood soaks through.
Raise the injured part above the heart if you can.
Alert the base if bleeding has not stopped after 10 minutes.

CRITICAL.text: Press hard on the wound with a cloth. Do not stop.
Do not lift the cloth. Add more on top if needed.
If blood still spurts from an arm or leg, use the kit tourniquet.
Lay the person down and keep them warm.

callBaseWhen: Call the base if bleeding does not stop after 10 minutes of pressure.
